entries.note: An empty container leaves the port of loading for the shipper to load; the cargo is not with Milaha yet.
The loaded container comes back from the shipper to the port of loading.
Loaded on the vessel at the port of loading, which then sails.
Discharged at a port where it changes vessel.
Moved on from the transhipment port towards the terminal of its next vessel.
Received at the terminal of its next vessel during transhipment.
Loaded on its next vessel at a transhipment port.
Discharged at the port of discharge, before the consignee collects it.
The loaded container leaves the port of discharge for the consignee.
The consignee unloaded the container and returned it empty.
